description: Deterministic TsukiAI Qwen3-TTS benchmark corpus for Gates 1, 2, 18, and 19.

rules.cache: Call the private Qwen worker directly so every request is an inference request.
rules.sampling: Do not change production sampling parameters between variants.

Before you deploy the new runtime, record the exact checkpoint, attention mode, thread counts, token ceiling, and machine type, then run the same short and long phrases so the speed difference can be reproduced later.

When a voice system becomes faster, I still want to hear stable pitch, natural rhythm, clean sentence endings, and the same recognizable character voice, because a performance win is not useful if the speaker suddenly sounds different.

A useful realtime pipeline should begin speaking soon, keep enough audio buffered to avoid starvation, discard stale speech after interruption, and continue to behave correctly when several requests arrive over a longer session.

For this benchmark, keep every sampling parameter fixed and change only the intended runtime variable, otherwise a faster result could come from a different generation behavior and the comparison would no longer be trustworthy.
Check the model identity first. Record the thread settings. Run the same fixed text. Save the timing and memory. Listen for missing endings. Keep the result only if every check passes.
